entries.zh: （身材）卑矮；矮个子的人〔原件西语栏残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: short of stature; a low/short man [source damaged; tentative]
entries.notes: 西语词头 gregüe[残]es（疑 gregües/gregüezas 类词）残缺，据汉字「卑矮」与下贱族语境定矮小义。

entries.zh: 下贱；卑贱（对人品行的贬斥）
entries.en: base, low, vile (of a person's status or conduct)

entries.zh: 下流；出身卑贱，言语污辱人（西语释义：出身低下、以言辱人）
entries.en: of low birth, mean; to insult with words (té chàbóa)

entries.zh: 下落来；落下来，降落
entries.en: to come down, descend, fall down

entries.zh: 崎落；陡峭的下坡，险峻下坠处
entries.en: a steep descent, precipitous slope downward

entries.zh: 贱人（汉字栏原写「儀子」，封存件疑为「僕」之误；闽南音并有 pīt hū，即「匹夫」，西语自注 better as vil）〔缩写展开与正字依赖推断〕
entries.en: a base, vile man (H column variant read 儀子, queried as 僕; M colloquially pīt hū = 匹夫)
entries.notes: source_H 汉字存疑（儀/僕），闽南音栏含修订旁注，正字无法定夺。

entries.zh: 贱人；卑贱之人
entries.en: a base person, mean fellow

entries.zh: 贱相；寒酸卑贱之相（西语 despasa 疑为 despacio/desposeído 类缩残，取「卑贱貌」义）〔西语词残，依赖推断〕
entries.en: a mean, base appearance; shabby look (Spanish headword partly damaged)
entries.notes: 西语词头 despasa 残缺，据汉字「賤相」定释义。

entries.zh: 匹夫；卑贱无识之男子
entries.en: a base, contemptible man (ordinary fellow)

entries.zh: 匹妇；卑贱之妇人
entries.en: a base, low woman (contemptible female)

entries.zh: 碌碌人材；庸碌无能之人，无足轻重的小人物
entries.en: a mediocre, insignificant man of little account

entries.zh: 鄙；卑鄙，粗俗低下
entries.en: low, mean, vulgar

entries.zh: 鄙陋；粗鄙浅陋
entries.en: mean and vulgar; rustic, uncultured

entries.zh: 下等人（闽南音 bou lâng fu lanw 对汉字栏不吻合，或为「无好夫男」类俗语；官话对音「問信」亦难对应）〔四栏不吻合，存疑〕
entries.en: a low, mean person (M and R lines do not match the H column; reading uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉字「其人」与闽南/官话音栏皆难互证，疑原稿另有俗语词，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 落可多；贬抑很深、使其地位大大下降
entries.en: to lower greatly, bring very low; to abase someone much

entries.zh: 海底礁石、浅滩（西语 Baxos del mar＝海中浅礁；汉字「老古石」为闽南俗名）〔释义依赖推断〕
entries.en: shoals, reefs of the sea; sunken rocks (M lines read lō cāu chiàu chá chiū, vernacular for sea rocks)
entries.notes: 汉字与音栏对应不直白（老古石为闽南礁石俗称），据西语 Baxos del mar 定浅礁义。

entries.zh: 低音筒（乐器）；音乐中的低音管状乐器〔汉字「筒/简」存疑〕
entries.en: bass (musical instrument, a large tube/lute-like bass, e.g. bajón = bassoon)
entries.notes: Bajón 17世纪指低音管（巴松前身）；汉字栏筒/简未定，据西语词头与对音 tāng 定筒。

entries.zh: 天平碗；称银（比索）用的天平盘、秤盘
entries.en: scales (balance pans) for weighing peso silver

entries.zh: 栏杆、扶栏（西语自注马来语 lancang，即栏杆柱）
entries.en: baluster, railing post (cf. Malay lancang)

entries.zh: 栏杆、栏栅
entries.en: balustrade, railing

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（仅存闽南音 lân cān chyl，疑为「栏杆之属」的延续词条）
entries.en: [source damaged; tentative] only Hokkien line survives: lân cān chyl, possibly a continuation of the railing entry
entries.notes: 西语与汉字栏皆空，闽南音末字 T99 污损难辨。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（仅存闽南音 lân cān，疑「栏杆」之又一写）
entries.en: [source damaged; tentative] only Hokkien line survives: lân cān, likely another form of 'railing'
entries.notes: 西语与汉字、官话栏皆空，仅可按音推「栏杆」义。
